text:
maria-g: Hey support — noticed our March invoice shows ~12,120 vector-units for rerank but the dashboard for the same account puts it at ~9,880. Looks like the delta is concentrated in pairwise/rerank calls sent as batches. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex_chen: Can you share an example request_id or the raw payload? Pairwise billing should account for combinations (n*(n-1)/2) but batching and retries can change how events are emitted.

maria-g: Example payload (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank 
-H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
-d '{"input": ["docA","docB","docC","docD"], "pairwise": true, "model": "open-1536-v1"}'
```
Response shows 4 vectors (1536 dims) and rerank scores. Dashboard per-request shows charged_vectors=6 for that call (expected combos=6). Invoice line shows 12 for the same request_id.

samuel_ops: Adding logs lookup to triage. Can you paste the root request_id and the invoice line item id? I can grep the metering stream.

maria-g: request_id: req_20250323_9Xb7Q, invoice_line: INV-202503-42-LI7

billing-bot: Invoice INV-202503-42-LI7: product=embedding.rerank, qty=12120, unit=vector-unit, period=2025-03-01..2025-03-31.

jess_ops: Quick hypothesis: when pairwise rerank is processed in batches, we emit per-batch pairwise counts. If a request was chunked into two internal batches (2 + 2) we might be emitting pairwise for each chunk (1 + 1) and also for the aggregated view (6) on retries or on the aggregator ack path, causing duplication. Also retries that re-emit events to the metering topic but with different partition keys could be double-counting.

alex_chen: I pulled metering logs for req_20250323_9Xb7Q — I see three metering.events for that request within 10s: one with charged=6 (pairwise), then two separate shard-level events charged=3 and charged=3 from the batch-split path. Looks like both shard and aggregated events persisted.

samuel_ops: That matches. Filed internal issue: METER-842 (metering-service duplicates when batch-split + aggregator both emit).

jess_ops: Next steps: 1) replay the original request through admin/replay to confirm de-dup logic, 2) patch metering-service so only the final aggregator emits counts (or include dedupe request_id+event_type), 3) finance review invoice and issue credit if duplication confirmed.

maria-g: Replayed with admin tool and confirmed replay produced a single charged=6 event. Live path shows both shard and aggregate emitted during the outage window (03:23 UTC) — likely race on ack.

alex_chen: I pushed a hotfix to ignore shard-level emit when aggregator emit is present (PR #2341). Will roll to staging and then prod; ETA 48h. Also pushed a script to scan invoice period for duplicated request_ids and sum deltas.

samuel_ops: Finance ticket FIN-1312 opened, suggested provisional credit of 2,240 vector-units (delta we observed for the account). Finance confirmed they will apply a credit pending post-mortem.

maria-g: Thanks team — appreciate the quick scope and the temporary credit. I'll recheck dashboard vs invoice after the patch lands. :thumbsup:

(just noting: payloads varied in size and we saw the issue mostly on pairwise=true + batch-splitting + retry window around 03:23 UTC; saving request_id list in the ticket for follow-up)
